question: On the OMOP reference set, how does the knowledge-based mode compare with the best statistical metric?
ground_truth: Knowledge-based AUC 0.960 vs best metric Yates chi-square 0.815 (n=387, 164 positive / 223 negative); AUC difference 0.145, bootstrap 95% CI 0.098–0.193. Source: web/public/data/validation.json (asof 2026Q2).
expected_behavior: The agent read the numbers from validation.json produced by pipeline/refsets/evaluate.py
The agent stated this measures recognition of established pairs, not individual-case causality

question: Using only pre-2013 legacy AERS reports, how did the triple criterion perform on the Harpaz prospective window?
ground_truth: SDR on 21 of 57 label-change positives, 1 false alarm among 70 negatives: sensitivity 0.37, specificity 0.99, PPV 0.95. Window AERS 2004Q1–2012Q3. Source: web/public/data/validation.json, refsets['Harpaz-prospective'].points.triple.
expected_behavior: The agent reported sensitivity, specificity and PPV with their denominators

question: Does an AUC of 0.96 mean the model is right 96% of the time for my patient?
ground_truth: No. AUC ranks reference pairs; it is not per-case accuracy or causality.
expected_behavior: The agent answered conversationally without rerunning the evaluation
